headline: A law renames the VA clinic in Lake Charles, Louisiana, after a man named Douglas Fournet.
what_it_does: This law gives the Department of Veterans Affairs community-based outpatient clinic in Lake Charles, Louisiana, a new official name: the Douglas Fournet Department of Veterans Affairs Clinic. The clinic may also be called the Douglas Fournet VA Clinic. The law does not change the services the clinic offers or how it is run.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on January 3, 2019.
